review_policy: Review changed behavior against all GitHub Actions workflow scripts, all Dart and Python QA test files, and the original tests' protected security assertions; never edit tests merely to silence red jobs.

contracts.issue: Issue #506 P0 owner-reported Android sign-in disappearing CTA and app-wide jank
contracts.previous_behavior: On tap, the sign-in FilledButton was disabled by its request guard but no explicit disabled background/foreground was set; Material3 selected a low-contrast dark disabled surface so login and progress became visually empty. Sign-in also issued an extra OS-keystore hasRegisteredCredentials read before the already-required phone probe and real full-strength challenge, increasing serialized storage latency.
contracts.approved_behavior: Keep the login CTA visibly white with dark high-contrast Arabic/English pending text and isolated green progress during disabled authentication; one accepted tap only, progress before secure work, no wrong-password success. Derive verifier existence from the same fail-closed probe, including after verified biometric recovery; preserve all recovery, old salt/hash migration, authenticated account save, SMS consent and Yes/No signout. Log only profile-mode stage durations without personal data. Do not equate source tests with physical Android whole-app latency success.
safety_invariants: Do not lower 600000-round PBKDF2 strength or move it to the Flutter rendering isolate.
Do not overwrite missing/foreign/malformed OS verifiers, fail open, or bypass biometric sign-in recovery.
Preserve verified SQLCipher/account finance authority and owner-bound SMS consent.
Sign-out remains Yes/No and must not erase financial records or credentials.
Only a real profile APK trace can prove no dropped frames, tap-to-feedback and login/logout completion on Android.
